title: Cosmic Melting Eye Blob
description: A surreal blue melting creature with a large yellow eye and open mouth occupies the lower half of the image. Above it, a massive cosmic eye filled with galaxies, aurora, planets, and nebulae sits within a translucent dome-like head, with a bright yellow light beam streaking from the top right through a starry space background.
prompt: A surreal blue melting slime creature with a large cartoonish yellow eye and open mouth, its translucent body dripping with bubbles and glitter. Above it floats a giant cosmic eye containing galaxies, aurora borealis, planets and nebulae within its iris, all encased in a glossy bubble-like head. A bright golden light beam shines from the top right corner across a dark starry space background with constellations.
